name: Agile ONE
summary: Munich's answer to the industrial humanoid race, from a company already selling force-controlled arms. Its case rests on the hands: 21 degrees of freedom each, with fingertip sensors and force-torque sensing at every joint, trained on one of Europe's largest real industrial datasets and aimed at fine manipulation rather than box moving.
notable: Trained on a large European industrial dataset
